Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager

Class ConnectionConfig

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager.ConnectionConfig
public final class ConnectionConfig extends Object
The typed settings of one named connection.

Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads. Every string form masks the password, the password inside a URL, and any option whose key names a secret, so a config can be logged and put in an exception message.

    • mask

      public static String mask(String text)
      Replaces the secrets in a text with MASK.

      Masks password=, passwd= and pwd= values and the password of a scheme://user:password@host URL. Use it before a URL goes into a message or a log.

      Parameters:
      text - the text, or null
      Returns:
      the masked text, or null when text is null
